capabilities: Open notes and images in a new pop-up window via right-click or command
Reuse an already open second window instead of spawning new ones
Stretch images to fill the full window size
disambiguation: Also known as Image Window; it opens existing vault files in pop-up windows rather than editing embedded images.
extras: Full documentation has moved to an external site. The plugin is in maintenance mode: PRs and bugs are reviewed, but feature requests are not being worked; the status is stated as not permanent.
intentEvidence: an enhancement to Obsidian's New Window functionality that adds features missing from the default behaviour
problem: Obsidian's built-in new window opens images at default size and in a new window each time, which is awkward for keeping an image on a second screen.
summary: Popout window plugin that opens images or notes in a separate Obsidian window, reusing one window and sizing images to fill it.
